## Orientation

Work in /home/ayin/se-workflow. Add scripts/session_report.py (the command) and tests/test_session_report.py. Reuse read_events from scripts/session_metrics.py, tool_metrics from scripts/session_tools.py and session_fields from scripts/session_fields.py. Do not edit those three files. Scripts import each other as top-level modules, so run the command as python3 scripts/session_report.py. Real transcripts live in ~/.claude/projects/<project>/*.jsonl and some files are huge. Smoke-test the real run with a timeout of 300 seconds and run it in the background if needed. Keep tests free of store access. Do not edit .artifacts/ or other tests.
